comment.text:
PROGRESS UPDATE - EMPTY-STATE SEARCH/FILTER ICON CORRECTNESS AUDIT

ACCOMPLISHED
Follow-up to the empty-state icon redesign: audited every table using the useTableEmptyState hook (14 pages) to confirm search.svg and filter.svg actually fire correctly, not just that an icon exists. Found and fixed 2 real bugs (a 3rd, Leads customer_type, turned out already fixed independently on dev):
1. OrdersList - Delivery Status filter was a real, working filter control but missing from customFilterCheckers, so filtering by it to zero results silently showed the generic icon instead of filter.svg. Also fixed a mind_date -> min_date typo in the same object (currently harmless since max_date still triggered detection, but dead/misleading).
2. Balances - the Pending Balance and Lifetime Orders tabs have real search + date-range filters but never called useTableEmptyState at all, so they always fell back to the Table default empty state with no search/filter distinction. Wired both tabs into the hook (separate instances so each keeps its own no-data message) and threaded the icon/message/button props into PendingBalance.jsx and LifetimeOrders.jsx.

EXTRA WORK
This was a defensive audit beyond the original icon-swap scope, done proactively after the icon redesign to make sure the new icon set is actually reachable in every state it was designed for.

PULL REQUESTS
Dev: https://github.com/Prosperna/prosperna1/pull/7621 (branch refactor/empty-state-icons-v2-dev3)

HOW IT WAS TESTED
npx eslint --fix on all touched files: clean
Targeted vitest run: Balances.test.jsx, LifetimeOrders.test.jsx, Leads index.test.jsx - 13/13 passing
Verified clean merge-tree against current origin/dev tip (no conflicts)

NEXT STEPS
Pending review and QA approval on dev PR #7621.

QA TEST CASES SUMMARY
LAST UPDATED: 2026-08-03, PR https://github.com/Prosperna/prosperna1/pull/7651

WHERE TO TEST
Environment: dev
Pages: Media Library, Orders list, Balances (Pending/Lifetime tabs), Withdrawal Settings > My Banks, Inventory > Inventory Logs (history icon on the inventory listing page), Notification Center (bell icon in header), Store Locations, Standard Reports, Product Labels > Add Product modal, Dashboard > Analytics > Most Visited Pages, Create Order > product picker, Contact profile > Order History tab, Inventory > product edit > Add Products to Location modal, Inventory > create product > Variants > combinations table
Preconditions: none special, any store account

TEST CASES

1-4. Media Library (icon + search/list/non-empty states) - unchanged from prior summary, still applicable.

5-6. OrdersList Delivery Status / date-only filter empty states - unchanged from prior summary.

7-9. Balances Pending/Lifetime Orders search and filter empty states - unchanged from prior summary.

10. (NEW, PR #7651) Withdrawal Settings > My Banks empty-state icon
Setup: a store with zero saved bank accounts
Steps: open Withdrawal Settings > My Banks tab
Expected: shows a new bank-building icon (not the old generic gray box), title No Banks Added Yet. Then type a search term matching no banks - icon switches to the magnifying-glass search icon with No Results Found copy.

11. (NEW) Inventory Logs search/filter empty states
Steps: open a products history/logs view, search a term with no matches; separately, pick a specific location filter with no logs for it
Expected: search shows the magnifying-glass icon; location filter (when more than one location exists) shows the funnel icon; genuinely empty (no filter/search) shows a new clock/history icon.

12. (NEW) Notification Center search empty state
Steps: open Notification Center (bell icon), search a term matching no notifications
Expected: magnifying-glass icon + no-results copy, distinct from the new bell-icon genuinely-empty state.

13. (NEW) Store Locations search empty state
Steps: open Store Locations settings, search a term matching no locations
Expected: magnifying-glass icon and copy, not the old plain text message that used to show here.

14. (NEW) Standard Reports empty states
Steps: open Standard Reports; apply just a status/payment/shipping-method/due-date filter that yields zero rows (leave date range on the default Last 7 Days); separately try a search term with no matches
Expected: filter case shows the funnel icon; search case shows the magnifying-glass icon; leaving everything on defaults with genuinely no report data shows a new bar-chart icon.

15. (NEW) Website Traffic (Dashboard > Analytics > Most Visited Pages) filter empty state
Steps: change Page Type or Date away from the default and pick a combination with zero visits
Expected: funnel icon shown, not the generic default.

16. (NEW) Product Labels > Add Product modal / Create Order product picker / Add Products to Location modal / Variant combinations table - search empty states
Steps: in each of these product-picker style tables, search a term matching nothing
Expected: each shows the magnifying-glass search icon and appropriate copy instead of a blank generic state.

17. (NEW) Contact profile > Order History tab search empty state
Steps: open a contact profile with orders, search a term matching none
Expected: magnifying-glass icon, This contact has not placed an order yet copy for the true-empty case.

18. Non-empty states unaffected across all of the above
Steps: verify normal data still renders correctly in every table listed
Expected: no regressions - only empty-state icon/message selection changed.

TEST DATA
No special test data or IDs needed for any case - use filter/search values that happen to match zero current records.

OUT OF SCOPE / KNOWN BEHAVIOR
Only the empty-state icon/message SELECTION logic changed on each page - no changes to actual filtering, search, or table data behavior. A follow-up admin-side batch (Account, AccountsActivityLog, BillingVerification, invoices pages, Rewards, SurveyResponse, TransactionReport, Transactions, Users, WithdrawalMerchants) has the same gap and is intentionally not included in this PR - do not flag those as regressions from this change.
